title: My Town
description: Practise town words, there is/are and relative clauses, then describe your town.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: 🏙️ ___ a big park in my town.
exercises.explanation: Use "There is" with one thing.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: The library is the place ___ I read books.
exercises.explanation: Use "where" for places.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I have lived here for ten years.
exercises.explanation: Subject + have + past participle + for + time.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: This is ___ shop in our town.
exercises.explanation: Use "the" + adjective + -est for the top one.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Last Sunday we go to the market.
answers: Last Sunday we went to the market.
exercises.explanation: "Last Sunday" is the past, so use went.

exercises.prompt: Finish the second sentence so it means the same. Use the word in capitals.
exercises.text: Minh came to this town five years ago.
answers: Minh has lived in this town for five years.
Minh has lived here for five years.
exercises.explanation: Use has lived + for to talk about time until now.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: The cinema is ___ the bank and the café.
exercises.explanation: "Between" is for two things, one on each side.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: Our town is ___ than the city. (quiet)
exercises.explanation: Short adjectives take -er: quieter.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: You should visit the old bridge.
exercises.explanation: Subject + should + base verb.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: I ___ never been to the zoo in the city.
exercises.explanation: Use have + never + past participle.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: There are not much shops near my house.
answers: There are not many shops near my house.
There aren't many shops near my house.
exercises.explanation: Use "many" with plural nouns.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ go to the museum.
exercises.explanation: If + present simple, then will + base verb.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: Nam is the boy ___ lives next to the post office.
exercises.explanation: Use "who" for a person.

exercises.prompt: Finish the second sentence so it means the same. Use the word in capitals.
exercises.text: I was walking in the park and I saw Anna.
answers: I saw Anna when I was walking in the park.
exercises.explanation: Put "when" before the longer action in progress.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: We ___ going to build a new school next year.
exercises.explanation: Use are going to with we.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: This is the longest street in our town.
exercises.explanation: This is the + superlative + in + place.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: Walk ___ the bridge and turn left.
exercises.explanation: We walk across a bridge.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: The streets in my town is very clean.
answers: The streets in my town are very clean.
exercises.explanation: "Streets" is plural, so use "are".

exercises.prompt: Finish the second sentence so it means the same. Use the word in capitals.
exercises.text: The market is smaller than the mall.
answers: The mall is bigger than the market.
exercises.explanation: Swap the two places and change smaller to bigger.

exercises.prompt: Write one word in the gap.
exercises.text: At eight o'clock yesterday, we ___ walking to school.
exercises.explanation: Use were with we in the past continuous.

task.prompt: A new friend from another country wants to know about your town. Write about it.
contentPoints: Say what there is in your town.
Say what you like about it.
task.modelAnswer: I live in a small town near the sea. There is a big park where children play and a market where people buy fresh fruit. The biggest building is the library. I like my town because it is quiet and friendly. If you visit, you should walk along the beach and try our noodle soup.
